notes.title: NEW UPDATE 1.1.0
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, please note that a new update has been released! 
Some of you have told us that you would like to be able to play with a gamepad and customize the keys for yourself. NOW ALL THIS IS AVAILABLE FOR YOU!

Here's what's been added:
- A more flexible CONTROL KEY CHANGE SYSTEM has been added to the settings.
- The game has been adapted for GAMEPAD
- More minor bugs fixed
- The game has become more optimized

I'm still working on the world generation system. My goal is to develop a system that will gradually increase the difficulty as you progress through the game and gradually introduce new content as you go.

Add your suggestion for the next update to the discussion.

notes.title: Infinity Castle Dungeon - Official Release!
notes.notes: From Monday the world can see INFINITY CASTLE DUNGEON and begin its endless exploration of the castle, fighting bosses and searching for treasure. Good luck and courage, because you will definitely need it.

notes.title: First Day Patch!
notes.notes:
[b]CHANGES:[/b]
[list]
[*]Sprite loading has been optimized.
[*]All red bots have been weakened.
[*]All purple bots have been weakened.
[*]Fixed a bug with opening the menu when clicking on a fugitive in the store.
[*]Fixed a bug with the boss changing when you die from it.
[/list]

notes.title: 0.5.1 ALPHA BUGFIX PATCH
notes.notes:
[b]List of fixed bugs:[/b]

[list]
[*]Implemented an ambulance calculation system
[*]Improved the animation of interaction with the bow
[*]Removed the ability to drink potions when in full health
[*]Fixed a bug with pushing enemies and items into other rooms
[*]Fixed a bug by updating the number of arrows and potions when entering the game
[*]Fixed bugs with the incorrect logic of route building for knights and removed their ability to pull you out of another room
[*]Fixed graphical differences between mimics and chests
[*]Fixed a bug with projectiles disappearing from frogs
[*]Fixed a bug with the skin product when leaving the previous profile
[*]Fixed a bug with hand animation in the mimic
[/list]

notes.title: 0.5.0 ALPHA BUGFIX PATCH
notes.notes:
[b]List of fixed bugs:[/b]

[list]
[*]Optimized the frog animator
[*]Fixed the rotation of swords created by sworders
[*]Removed the “Morty” profile that appeared on all players.
[*]Fixed the very loud sound of moving spikes.
[*]Removed the ability to close the death screen using Escape and Tab.
[*]Fixed a bug with the cursor disappearing in the inventory.
[*]The settings change immediately, not after clicking a checkmark.
[*]Fixed a problem with changing the screen size settings.
[*]Fixed a bug with the simultaneous opening of 2 chests.
[*]Added the ability to quickly move an object with a double click.
[/list]
